title: Tesorio Is NetSuite Next Ready
body_markdown:
On August 18, 2026, Tesorio completed NetSuite Next Ready validation. The new badge now appears on our SuiteApp listing alongside the AI Application badge Tesorio already held.


Badges are easy to skip past. This one arrives at a specific moment: Oracle is rolling out a new NetSuite experience in phases, and finance teams are taking inventory of what they have connected to the ERP.


## What NetSuite Next brings


[NetSuite Next](https://www.oracle.com/in/news/announcement/sw25-netsuite-launches-netsuite-next-2025-10-07/) is Oracle's new AI-powered experience for NetSuite. Its redesigned interface brings embedded AI and Ask Oracle to the platform finance teams already use. Oracle is making it available in phases, and customers receive an in-app notification when their account becomes eligible.


[Ask Oracle](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/netsuite/ns-online-help/article_5100902387.html) gives finance users a natural-language way to work with NetSuite data. A user can ask for overdue invoices without finding the right report first. When Ask Oracle proposes a protected action, one that could change data or continue a process, it may pause for approval before proceeding.


That changes how finance teams find information and act on it inside the ERP. It also raises a practical question for every application connected to NetSuite: is it ready for the new experience?


## What the badge means for Tesorio customers


NetSuite Next Ready is separate from Tesorio's existing AI Application badge. The new item is the validation itself, and it applies to the Tesorio SuiteApp already listed on SuiteApp.com.


As your company prepares for NetSuite Next, you can include Tesorio in that plan with its Next Ready validation complete. Your activation timing still follows Oracle's phased rollout.


## Where Tesorio is headed


Ask Oracle helps users find information and take supported actions inside NetSuite. Tesorio is building AI into the order-to-cash work that begins once an invoice is created and continues through customer communication, AP portals, collections, payment, cash application, and forecasting.


At our first Tesorio Live, CEO Carlos Vega explained how Tesorio is building toward an agentic order-to-cash analyst that coordinates routine work from contract review through payment reconciliation. The vision spans reviewing contracts, delivering invoices, submitting them through AP portals, following up on payment, applying cash, and updating the forecast.


Carlos calls that goal Close Won & Done. Agents handle the busywork; finance teams retain control of exceptions and judgment.


## See Tesorio at SuiteWorld


We will be at[SuiteWorld](https://community.oracle.com/netsuite/english/events/11983-suiteworld-october-25-28-2026-las-vegas) , October 25-28, 2026, in Las Vegas. If you are planning for NetSuite Next and want to talk through what your order-to-cash process could look like, come find us.
